stem: Which sentence from paragraph 5 best illustrates the author’s feeling that her life experiences have made her more confident?

options.label: A
options.text: During our visit we commented to each other how the colors, unlike the desert’s browns and dull greens, were an elegant mix of reds, pinks, and yellows.

options.label: B
options.text: In high school, I was standing on top of the rocks, but no incisions had been made—no canyon had been formed.

options.label: C
options.text: There was a river and it was flowing, but I did not see the layers beneath.

options.label: D
options.text: I have faith that in the end that process will reveal magnificent layers that inspire rather than repress and remain buried.
